description: aiter FlyDSL fused MoE stage-2: per-expert down-projection GEMM (afp8 act x mxfp4 w2 -> bf16) over the sorted (token,slot) pairs, plus the top-16 expert combine. Both hot kernels (mfma_moe2_..._cshuffle_t64x256x128_..._acc0 and moe_reduction_kernel_plain_bf16_topk16_md3584) execute inside this ONE call, which is why the call is the timed unit and the byte-reduction lever (fusing the combine into the cshuffle epilogue) is expressible without touching the seam.
rebind_seam_note: The live dispatch is AiterRunnerCore.run -> aiter.fused_moe:fused_moe -> _flydsl_stage2_wrapper -> aiter.ops.flydsl.flydsl_moe_stage2. A candidate integrates by replacing aiter.ops.flydsl.flydsl_moe_stage2 (package attribute AND aiter.ops.flydsl.moe_kernels.flydsl_moe_stage2) via a PYTHONPATH sitecustomize overlay; the wrapper resolves its tile/mode kwargs from get_flydsl_kernel_params(kernelName) and passes them through, so a replacement must accept the same keyword set.

quant.act_dtype: float8_e4m3fn (dynamic per-pair mx quant, e8m0 scales)
quant.source: config.text_config.quantization_config (compressed-tensors Mxfp4MoEMethod); parse_regime.py reported method=none because the quantization_config is nested under text_config

regime.notes: prefill_chunk from the live server log (chunked_prefill_size=16384); decode runs under HIP graph replay (cuda_graph=true), prefill runs eager.

tol_note: 0.05 (not the usual 0.02): the DECODE launch variant this seam selects at bs>=16 is mode='atomic' -- the top-16 combine accumulates with bf16 atomics, so the summation order, and therefore the rounding, is NOT reproducible run to run. The FROZEN baseline disagrees with its own previous output by 2-3 bf16 ULP (max |diff| 8-12 at |ref|~570, 5-8 of 229376 elements) on decode_M64. Measured over 4 independent baseline-vs-oracle trials, tol=0.02/0.03 fail and tol=0.05 passes with margin (worst observed err 0.45). The prefill variant (mode='reduce') is bitwise deterministic and matches at err=0.0.
